data.body:
Completion gate returned FAIL at 2026-09-19T23:2x — investigated before re-running, and the FAIL was not about this ticket's criteria.

The gate was started without an explicit `ref`, so it verified against the store repository's checked-out HEAD (`e900fa14ad5`, 2026-09-19 00:40 UTC) rather than current `origin/main`. This ticket's fix merged as `9f67fcfef7a`, which is reachable from `origin/main` but **not** from that stale HEAD, so the "work landed" precheck failed before any criteria were judged.

Confirming evidence: zero `COMPLETION_VERDICT` events were written to this ticket's directory. A real criteria judgement always writes one with a per-criterion `met` array. The control is `16c9-a42d` and `5a31-8c91`, verified in the same session with an explicit `ref` — both PASSed and both recorded a verdict.

Re-running now with `ref=d5c325a4170dfee29af010164a1cc2e3289cdc83`. The description and acceptance criteria were not changed, because nothing about them was implicated.

The misleading failure shape is filed separately as `selective-dermic-coelacanth` (c6fb-49cf).
